text_blocks.snippet: The BinaxNOW COVID-19 Test is a rapid antigen test that can detect the presence of SARS-CoV-2 virus, the virus that causes COVID-19. It is an over-the-counter (OTC) test that can be used at home.

list.snippet: The test kit includes a nasal swab, a test card, and a buffer solution.
The user collects a nasal swab sample by inserting the swab into one nostril and gently rubbing it along the inside wall.
The swab is then placed into the buffer solution.
The buffer solution is dropped onto the test card.
Results are visible in as little as 15 minutes.
The BinaxNOW COVID-19 Test has been shown to be accurate in detecting the virus in individuals with symptoms of COVID-19.
However, it is important to note that no test is perfect, and there may be false positive or false negative results.
The BinaxNOW COVID-19 Test is available at most pharmacies and online retailers.
The cost of the BinaxNOW COVID-19 Test may vary depending on the retailer.
The test is not intended for use in individuals under the age of 15.
It is recommended to consult with a healthcare provider if you have any questions about using the BinaxNOW COVID-19 Test.
